newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso edges up in steady trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso edges up in steady trading.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed up 1.25 pesos against the dollar at 1,075.15 in steady trading, interbank dealers said.

The peso strengthened toward the end of the session as dollar earnings from coffee exports flowed into the market. Earlier in trading the dollar rate had been buoyed by demand for greenbacks from banks and industry, including airlines.
Dealers reported 341 trades worth a total $154 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,074.5 and sank to an intraday low of 1,078.45.
